name: io.github.yaniswav/topicforge
title: TopicForge
description: Read-only MCP server for ROS2 and DDS: topics, participants, QoS mismatches, bags.

environmentVariables.name: TOPICFORGE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: mock (deterministic fixtures, no ROS2 needed), live, or auto. Defaults to auto.

environmentVariables.name: TOPICFORGE_DDS_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: DDS backend: mock, cyclone, fast, or auto. Requires the matching extra, e.g. pip install topicforge[dds].

environmentVariables.name: TOPICFORGE_DDS_DOMAIN_ID
environmentVariables.description: DDS domain id to observe, 0-232. Joined at startup; changing it requires a restart.

environmentVariables.name: TOPICFORGE_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in anonymous telemetry, off by default. When off, no network code path executes.
